notes.title: Non-VR version & Joypad/Mouse/Keyboard support update
notes.content:
Hi all, I just wanted to give you a quick update on where I'm at with the non-VR version and alternative control support which is now fully operational and works really well in my opinion.

Handling objects with a joypad or mouse works in much the same way as Skyrim or Amnesia in which the object is held in front of the player and can be rotated.

This has required some task & scenery changes that work better with VR now being optional.

The update is currently being play-tested & polished and should be available within the next few days all being well.

Cheers.

notes.title: MAJOR GAME UPDATE FOR THE OCULUS TOUCH LAUNCH!
notes.content:
Hi all, I'd like to announce that for the [b]Oculus Touch launch[/b] I have been working on a big update to Marlene, taking on board feedback that I have received.

Additions will include:
More puzzles!
Graphics changes and upgrades - Let's get a big ol' moon in that sky.
More objects to interact with.
More sound effects - Why does that keypad not beep?
More story notes to flesh out the narrative
and more "surprises"

If you have already played Marlene this update will be well worth another play through.

Oculus Touch support is now fully functional and ready to go live for the launch of the Touch controllers.

Hope you're looking forward to it and thanks for all the support and feedback!

tags.feature: - Graphics changes and upgrades - Let's get a big ol' moon in that sky.
- More sound effects - Why does that keypad not beep?
- More story notes to flesh out the narrative
- Oculus Touch support is now fully functional and ready to go live for the launch of the Touch controllers.

notes.title: STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS & FUTURE UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hi all, I hope your enjoying this Halloween weekend with scary movies and scary games!

I just want to give you a quick update of future plans I have for Marlene.

I am currently working on the inclusion of some fun Steam achievements which will also include substantial changes to the puzzle object locations, added sound effects and unexpected moments from the original release. Perfect for a second play-through!

Work will then commence on Act 2 which will be based around the cottage in which you will play as another lead character in the story.

I would also appreciate a quick review of the game after your play through and any feedback you might have. 

Have a great one!

notes.title: Marlene feedback and patch today
notes.content:
Hi all, I hope you are enjoying the game and thanks for all the feedback so far.

As I am hearing reports on performance issues in the opening area I will be putting out a patch today that will hopefully fix this. If you are supersampling via Steam renderTargetMultiplier this may also cause performance issues if set too high. I run a 1080 GTX at 1.2.

I will also tweak the darkness at the beginning of the game and/or give the player a more efficient torch light.

The keypad in the hallway cannot be accessed until the gas is switched off, this will be also be signposted more clearly in the patch.
